trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The loup garou has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The loup garou regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn unless it took damage from a silver weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The loup garou makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Swipe (1 Action)
entries: The loup garou makes one Claws attack.

legendary.name: Mauling Pounce (2 Actions)
entries: The loup garou moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes one Claws attack against each creature it moves past.
